text:
Maya: Heads up team — Sales flagged ~8 customers as renewal-risk but with active migration plans. Proposal: run a 75m Migration Validation Workshop aimed at clearing blockers and producing a migration sign-off checklist. Want to schedule and divvy up prework today.
Owen: Good plan. Who should we invite from customers? technical owners + CSMs?
Maya: Technical owners + their platform lead, CSM on the account, and 1 sales rep (for contract nuance). Keep it invite-only.
Diego: I can own the migration lab (app config, inference tuning). Prefer Wed June 7 11:00 AM PT.
Priya: I'll cover cost/perf tuning and provide a short before/after cost estimation template.
Ruth (CS): We'll need a short pre-survey to capture current infra, key blockers, and desired success criteria. I can make a form and gate lab seats to those who submit it.
Maya: Perfect. Also want a renewal-readiness rubric we can hand off to AE: green/yellow/red with ask items.
Owen: For logistics: cap interactive lab to 12 seats, run a parallel Q&A room for others. Recording + tailored follow-up per account.
enablement-bot: Reminder: upload any shared playbooks to /Enablement/Migration-Validation/ and tag #enablement by EOD Tue.
Diego: For the lab we'll need sample config templates and a small dataset. Suggest we provide a tiny replica dataset to avoid exposing customer data.
Priya: Agreed. I'll prepare cost templates and an example terraform snippet for autoscale rules.
Maya: Agenda draft:
- 5m intros + objectives (Maya)
- 15m migration sign-off rubric & prerequisites (Owen)
- 20m live lab demo: migration flow + tuning (Diego)
- 20m hands-on breakout lab (12 seats) + parallel Q&A
- 10m next steps & account-specific actions (CS + AE)
Ruth (CS): I'll build the form with fields: account name, technical contact, current infra summary, main blocker, urgency, preferred hands-on (y/n). Will post link in 30m.
Owen: Can someone draft a short RSVP blurb for AEs? e.g., "Migration Validation Workshop — targeted session to unblock your migration and provide a migration sign-off checklist." Keep <200 chars.
Priya: Draft: "Migration Validation Workshop — join a targeted 75m session to validate your Dedicated migration plan, get tuning tips, and leave with a sign-off checklist."
Maya: Nice. Action items:
- Ruth: pre-survey form + initial invite list (today EOB)
- Diego: lab assets + replica dataset + instructions (by Fri)
- Priya: cost/perf templates + terraform snippet (by Thu)
- Owen: rubric doc + AE checklist (by Thu)
- Maya: confirm date/time and publish invite to AEs (tomorrow)
Ruth (CS): Form link: https://forms.gle/mig-validate-xyz — will DM AEs first, then add to calendar event once we have confirmed accounts.
Diego: Volunteers to help run breakout lab rooms? react with :raised_hand: and I'll assign rooms.
Priya: :raised_hand:
Owen: :raised_hand:
Maya: Please keep the invite list tight — this is to drive renewals, not a broad training. Tag #sales-eng when you post final invite so AEs know follow-up expectations.
Ruth (CS): Adding a column in the signup sheet for "post-workshop next action" to make handoffs explicit.
Maya: Thanks — aim to lock attendee list and final agenda by Tuesday 10am PT. Posting updates here keeps the audit trail. Closing for now; reopen if timelines slip.
